experiment: Total Quorum Loss and Primary Step-Down

timeline.event: Cluster healthy; all 3 nodes in full consensus quorum
timeline.notes: 3 of 3 voting members alive (100% > 50% majority threshold). Active writes processed normally.

timeline.event: Secondary-1 (mongo-rs0-2) disconnected via Docker network command
timeline.notes: Surviving voting members: 2/3 (66.7%). Majority quorum maintained; primary retains role.

timeline.event: Secondary-2 (mongo-rs0-3) disconnected; Primary is completely isolated
timeline.notes: Surviving voting members: 1/3 (33.3% < 50% threshold). Majority quorum LOST.

timeline.event: Attempted w:majority write operation with wtimeout=3000ms
timeline.notes: Primary blocked waiting for second acknowledgment; timed out after 3000ms. No data committed.

timeline.event: Primary detected loss of majority heartbeats; rs.stepDown() triggered automatically
timeline.notes: CRITICAL MOMENT: At 16:51:21.685 UTC, Primary demoted itself to prevent split-brain writes (CAP consistency).

timeline.event: Replica set enforces strict read-only mode (Zero primaries in cluster)
timeline.notes: All incoming client write operations are rejected immediately. Reads remain available on secondaries.

timeline.event: docker network connect executed for both secondaries (mongo-rs0-2 & mongo-rs0-3)
timeline.notes: Heartbeats restored across all 3 nodes; election protocol (Raft-variant) initiated.
At 16:51:25.686 UTC, mongo-rs0-1 elected Primary due to highest priority (2.0) and latest optime. All nodes healthy.
